name: v1.21.0
body:
## What's Changed
* feat(model): the ModelScene frame type, WMO backdrops, and the Broodwatch game by @brues-code in https://github.com/brues-code/ClassicAPI/pull/138
* feat(model): scene:SetWorldTerrain, a map's ground, water and sky in a ModelScene by @brues-code in https://github.com/brues-code/ClassicAPI/pull/139
* feat(addons): zhCN localization for ClassicAPI_DebugTools and 6 missing globals fix by @jilinge in https://github.com/brues-code/ClassicAPI/pull/141
* docs: an API descriptor for every registration by @brues-code in https://github.com/brues-code/ClassicAPI/pull/144

## New Contributors
* @jilinge made their first contribution in https://github.com/brues-code/ClassicAPI/pull/141

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/brues-code/ClassicAPI/compare/v1.20.6...v1.21.0
